[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/02/13 (Mon) 10:13  
[FACT] User is looking for new recipe ideas for meal prep on the weekends.  
[PREFERENCE] User wants healthy and easy-to-make dishes that can be reheated throughout the week.  
[PREFERENCE] User has been enjoying the convenience of food delivery services but wants to cook more at home to eat healthier.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Cooking at home is a great way to take control of nutrition and health.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested meal prep ideas include:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Grilled Chicken Breast with Quinoa and Veggies: Marinate chicken breast, grill, and serve with quinoa and roasted veggies.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Lentil or Black Bean Soup: Cook lentils or black beans with diced veggies and spices, then portion into containers.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Turkey or Veggie Meatballs: Make meatballs using ground turkey or veggies, served with brown rice, quinoa, or whole-grain pasta.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Roasted Veggie Bowls: Roast a variety of veggies and portion with quinoa or brown rice.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Veggie Stir-Fry: Cook a big batch of stir-fry with favorite veggies and serve with brown rice or whole-grain noodles.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Quinoa Salads: Cook quinoa and mix with roasted veggies and a citrus vinaigrette.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. Mexican Chili: Cook chili with ground turkey or beans, served with brown rice or whole-grain tortillas.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 8. Indian-Style Lentil Curry: Cook lentils with spices, served with brown rice or naan.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 9. Korean-Style Chicken and Veggies: Marinate chicken in a Korean sauce, grill, and serve with veggies and brown rice.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for meal prep include using a slow cooker or Instant Pot, experimenting with spices, adding nuts or seeds, and portioning meals into containers.  
[PREFERENCE] User likes the idea of grilled chicken breast with quinoa and veggies.

[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Avocado-Cilantro Sauce: Blend avocado, cilantro, lime juice, salt, and pepper.
